Name: Alternate Seasonal Portraits for Stardew Kids Expansion
Author: medicsun
Description:
[b][size=4]The BluChick team has been working on Stardew Kids Expansion. These portraits are now base mod! I've archived the files as they're no longer needed.[/size][/b][size=4][b]

[/b][/size]Check out [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]DSV on nexus[/url] to get the rest of the kids (and theres another DSV SKE portrait style by Camtherata in it, you can see all the [url=https://diversestardewvalley.weebly.com/compatibility.html]options on DSV's website[/url]!)

New Config Options for Seasonal Outfits
Full - All seasons, + outdoor/indoor winter outfits
Vanilla - Spring outfit for spring, summer, and fall, and only outdoor winter outfit
Off - Just spring outfit for all year

I didn't do all the sprites because some of them are specific to Jas/Vincent, I will update if Stardew Kids Expansion ever starts to use them.

Tina has 2 versions, one that's very similar to the original Tina, and a visibly-mixed version because the original didn't really make sense to me

My personal age ranges for the kids (there's plenty of development between these ages, but considering the cartoony style, it could go either-or.)
Vanessa - 10-13
Tina - 5-7
Douglas - 8-11
James - 11-14
Adrian - 5-7
